verses.sloka: सह तारा अंगदाभ्याम् तु संगम्य हनुमान् कपिः ।विचिनोति च विन्ध्यस्य गुहाः च गहनानि च ॥४-५०-१॥
verses.transliteration: saha tārā aṁgadābhyām tu saṁgamya hanumān kapiḥ ।vicinoti ca vindhyasya guhāḥ ca gahanāni ca ॥4-50-1॥

translations.english: Hanuman, together with the monkeys, Tara and Angada, searched in the impenetrable places and caves of Vindhya.
translations.hindi: —— एकपञ्चाशः सग : ७0 प्र इत्युक्त्वा हजुभांस्तत्र पुनः कृष्णाजिनाम्वरार | अब्रवीत्तां महाभागां तापसीं पमेचारिणीए

verses.sloka: सिंह शार्दूल जुष्टाः च गुहाः च परितः तथा ।विषमेषु नग इन्द्रस्य महा प्रस्रवणेषु च ॥४-५०-२॥
verses.transliteration: siṁha śārdūla juṣṭāḥ ca guhāḥ ca paritaḥ tathā ।viṣameṣu naga indrasya mahā prasravaṇeṣu ca ॥4-50-2॥

translations.english: They also searched near rivers, mountain streams, hill ranges, caves of lions and tigers, in the rock shelters and difficult spots of vast mountains.
translations.hindi: यह कह हनुमान जी ने फिर उस चीर और ऋष्णाजिन (काले हिरन का चाम) के वस्त्र धारण करले वालो, महाभागा आर घसेचारिणी स्री से कह! .!१॥ ँ इदं प्रविष्ठाः सहसा बिलं तिमिरसंद्रतम्‌ ! क्षुत्पिपासापरिश्रान्ता: परिखिनाश्च सर्वशः ॥२] हम सब लोग थक सादे भूखे प्यासे और सब प्रकार से खिन्न हो कर, सहसा इस अंधकारपूर्ण बिल में चले आए हैं

verses.sloka: आसेदुः तस्य शैलस्य कोटिम् दक्षिण पस्चिमाम् ।तेषाम् तत्र एव वसताम् स कालो व्यत्यवर्तत ॥४-५०-३॥
verses.transliteration: āseduḥ tasya śailasya koṭim dakṣiṇa pascimām ।teṣām tatra eva vasatām sa kālo vyatyavartata ॥4-50-3॥

translations.english: They reached the end of the southwest side of the mountain(Vindhya). While they were still there, the time stipulated for them (to find Sita) had slipped.
translations.hindi: हम लोग बिशेष कर प्यासे होने के कारण ही इस बड़े भारी बल सं चले आए हू, परन्तु बहा पर इन अनेक प्रकार के अदू मुत पदार्था को देख कर, अधिक व्यथित और विकल होने के कारण हम सब अचेत से हो रहे हैं। ये सब मध्याहकालीन सूयं की तरह चम कीले सोने के वृक्ष किसके हैं ?

verses.sloka: स हि देशो दुरन्वेष्यो गुहा गहनवान् महान् ।तत्र वायु सुतः सर्वम् विचिनोति स्म पर्वतम् ॥४-५०-४॥
verses.transliteration: sa hi deśo duranveṣyo guhā gahanavān mahān ।tatra vāyu sutaḥ sarvam vicinoti sma parvatam ॥4-50-4॥

translations.english: The son of the Windgod, Hanuman, searched all over the mountains and caves and woods difficult to access in that southwestern region of the mountain.
translations.hindi: ये सब पवित्र ओड्य़ पदार्थ फल मूलादि किसके हूँ ? ये सोने के सतखने भवन आर चाँदी के घर .

verses.sloka: परस्परेण रहिता अन्योन्यस्य अविदूरतः ।गजो गवाक्षो गवयः शरभो गन्धमादनः ॥४-५०-५॥
verses.transliteration: paraspareṇa rahitā anyonyasya avidūrataḥ ।gajo gavākṣo gavayaḥ śarabho gandhamādanaḥ ॥4-50-5॥

translations.english: Having explored the region surrounded by a network of mountains, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sarabha, Gandhamadana, Mainda and also Dvivida, Sushena, Jambavan, Angada the heir apparent, Tara the forestdweller staying close to one another and Hanuman too not far from the others searched in the southern direction. While they were exploring, they saw the mouth of a large cave called Rikshabilam, which had its mouth open, guarded by a demon.

verses.sloka: मैन्दः च द्विविदः चैव हनुमान् जांबवान् अपि ।अंगदो युव राजः च तारः च वनगोचरः ॥४-५०-६॥
verses.transliteration: maindaḥ ca dvividaḥ caiva hanumān jāṁbavān api ।aṁgado yuva rājaḥ ca tāraḥ ca vanagocaraḥ ॥4-50-6॥

translations.english: Having explored the region surrounded by a network of mountains, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sarabha, Gandhamadana, Mainda and also Dvivida, Sushena, Jambavan, Angada the heir apparent, Tara the forestdweller staying close to one another and Hanuman too not far from the others searched in the southern direction. While they were exploring, they saw the mouth of a large cave called Rikshabilam, which had its mouth open, guarded by a demon.
translations.hindi: जो सोने के मरोखां से युक्त हैं और जिन पर मणियों के पदे पड़े हैं, किसके हैं? ये सब फल-फूल-युक्त पेड़, जिनक्री पवित्र सुगन्ध .फेली हुई है,

verses.sloka: गिरि जाल आवृतान् देशान् मार्गित्वा दक्षिणाम् दिशम् ।विचिन्वन्तः ततः तत्र ददृशुः विवृतम् बिलम् ॥४-५०-७॥
verses.transliteration: giri jāla āvṛtān deśān mārgitvā dakṣiṇām diśam ।vicinvantaḥ tataḥ tatra dadṛśuḥ vivṛtam bilam ॥4-50-7॥

translations.english: Having explored the region surrounded by a network of mountains, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sarabha, Gandhamadana, Mainda and also Dvivida, Sushena, Jambavan, Angada the heir apparent, Tara the forestdweller staying close to one another and Hanuman too not far from the others searched in the southern direction. While they were exploring, they saw the mouth of a large cave called Rikshabilam, which had its mouth open, guarded by a demon.
translations.hindi: ये सब सुवर्णमत्र दक्ष तथा निर्मल जल में ये सब सुवर्णमय कमल, किसके तेज से फूल रहे हँ

verses.sloka: दुर्गम् ऋक्ष बिलम् नाम दानवेन अभिरक्षितम् ।क्षुत् पिपासा परीताः तु श्रान्ताः तु सलिल अर्थिनः ॥४-५०-८॥
verses.transliteration: durgam ṛkṣa bilam nāma dānavena abhirakṣitam ।kṣut pipāsā parītāḥ tu śrāntāḥ tu salila arthinaḥ ॥4-50-8॥

translations.english: Overcome with hunger and thirst, the exhausted monkeys noticed a huge cave covered with creepers and bushes, while they were looking around for water.
translations.hindi: ये सोने को मछलियाँ कछुओं सहित जल में क्योंकर बिचरती हैं ! क्या ये सब चमत्कार आपके तपःप्रभाव के फलस्वरूप हैं अथवा किसी अन्य के

verses.sloka: अवकीर्णम् लता वृक्षैः ददृशुः ते महा बिलम् ।तत्र क्रौन्चाः च हंसाः च सारसाः च अपि निष्क्रमन् ॥४-५०-९॥
verses.transliteration: avakīrṇam latā vṛkṣaiḥ dadṛśuḥ te mahā bilam ।tatra krauncāḥ ca haṁsāḥ ca sārasāḥ ca api niṣkraman ॥4-50-9॥

translations.english: Just then, the kraunchas, swans, geese and chakravaka drenched in water with their limbs reddened with the pollen of lotuses were fluttering out (of the cave).

verses.sloka: जल आर्द्राः चक्रवाकाः च रक्त अंगाः पद्म रेणुभिः ।ततः तत् बिलम् आसाद्य सुगन्धि दुरतिक्रमम् ॥४-५०-१०॥
verses.transliteration: jala ārdrāḥ cakravākāḥ ca rakta aṁgāḥ padma reṇubhiḥ ।tataḥ tat bilam āsādya sugandhi duratikramam ॥4-50-10॥

translations.english: The bulls among the monkeys were bewildered when they reached the cave which was difficult to access.
translations.hindi: जो सब प्राणियों के ऊपर दया करने वालो थी, हनुमान जी के प्रश्नों का उत्तर देती हुई कहने लगी । ` महातेजस्वी मय नाम का एक सायावी श्रेष्ठ दानव था

verses.sloka: विस्मय व्यग्र मनसो बभूवुः वानरर्षभाः ।संजात परिशंकाः ते तत् बिलम् प्लवग उत्तमाः ॥४-५०-११॥
verses.transliteration: vismaya vyagra manaso babhūvuḥ vānararṣabhāḥ ।saṁjāta pariśaṁkāḥ te tat bilam plavaga uttamāḥ ॥4-50-11॥

translations.english: The brilliant host of monkeys experienced both fear and joy to see the cave difficult to enter.

verses.sloka: अभ्यपद्यन्त संहृष्टाः तेजोवन्तो महाबलाः ।नाना सत्त्व समाकीर्णाम् दैत्य इन्द्र निलय उपमम् ॥४-५०-१२॥
verses.transliteration: abhyapadyanta saṁhṛṣṭāḥ tejovanto mahābalāḥ ।nānā sattva samākīrṇām daitya indra nilaya upamam ॥4-50-12॥

translations.english: The cave was crowded with creatures of different kinds. It looked like the abode of the king of demons difficult (to enter), dreadful and impenetrable.

verses.sloka: दुर्दर्शम् इव घोरम् च दुर्विगाह्यम् च सर्वशः ।ततः पर्वत कूट आभो हनुमान् मारुत आत्मजः ॥४-५०-१३॥
verses.transliteration: durdarśam iva ghoram ca durvigāhyam ca sarvaśaḥ ।tataḥ parvata kūṭa ābho hanumān māruta ātmajaḥ ॥4-50-13॥

translations.english: Then Hanuman, son of the Windgod who appeared like a huge mountain and knew about forests spoke to the fellowmonkeys:
translations.hindi: पितामह ब्रह्मा जो से यह वर पाया कि शिल्पविद्या सम्बन्धी जो विद्या शुक्राचाय ने बनाई है, उसका समस्त ज्ञान उसको हो । वह महाबली इस वन को बना, यहाँ की समस्त भोग्य वस्तुओं का स्वामी हो गया

verses.sloka: अब्रवीत् वानरान् घोरान् कान्तार वन कोविदः ।गिरि जाल आवृतान् देशान् मार्गित्वा दक्षिणाम् दिशम् ॥४-५०-१४॥
verses.transliteration: abravīt vānarān ghorān kāntāra vana kovidaḥ ।giri jāla āvṛtān deśān mārgitvā dakṣiṇām diśam ॥4-50-14॥

translations.english: 'Going round the places covering all mountain ranges in the southern direction, we are spent. But we could not see Maithili.
translations.hindi: वह इस महाजन में कुळ दिनों तक सुखूर्वक रहा। फिर वह हेमा नाशक एक अप्सरा पर आसक्त हो गथा

verses.sloka: वयम् सर्वे परिश्रांता न च पश्याम मैथिलीम् ।अस्मात् च अपि बिलात् हंसाः क्रौन्चाः च सह सारसैः ॥४-५०-१५॥
verses.transliteration: vayam sarve pariśrāṁtā na ca paśyāma maithilīm ।asmāt ca api bilāt haṁsāḥ krauncāḥ ca saha sārasaiḥ ॥4-50-15॥

translations.english: 'From this cave have emerged several birds like sarasas, swans, kraunchas and chakravakas drenched in water. Surely there must be a source of plenty of water or well or a pond. Moreover there are shining( green) trees at the entrance of the cave (suggesting subsoil water).'

verses.sloka: जल आर्द्राः चक्रवाकाः च निष्पतन्ति स्म सर्वशः ।नूनम् सलिलवान् अत्र कूपो वा यदि वा ह्रदः ॥४-५०-१६॥
verses.transliteration: jala ārdrāḥ cakravākāḥ ca niṣpatanti sma sarvaśaḥ ।nūnam salilavān atra kūpo vā yadi vā hradaḥ ॥4-50-16॥

translations.english: 'From this cave have emerged several birds like sarasas, swans, kraunchas and chakravakas drenched in water. Surely there must be a source of plenty of water or well or a pond. Moreover there are shining( green) trees at the entrance of the cave (suggesting subsoil water).'

verses.sloka: तथा च इमे बिल द्वारे स्निग्धाः तिष्ठन्ति पादपाः ।इति उक्ताः तत् बिलम् सर्वे विविशुः तिमिर आवृतम् ॥४-५०-१७॥
verses.transliteration: tathā ca ime bila dvāre snigdhāḥ tiṣṭhanti pādapāḥ ।iti uktāḥ tat bilam sarve viviśuḥ timira āvṛtam ॥4-50-17॥

translations.english: On hearing him, the monkeys entered the cave full of darkness. There was no light of the Moon or the Sun. It was a horripilating experience.
translations.hindi: हे वानरोत्तम! में हेमा के इस भवन की रखवाली किआ करती हूँ। मेरी प्यारी सखी हेमा नाचने गाने में बड़ी निपुण है

verses.sloka: अचन्द्र सूर्यम् हरयो ददृशू रोम हर्षणम् ।निशम्य तस्मात् सिंहाः च तान् तान् च मृग पक्षिणः ॥४-५०-१८॥
verses.transliteration: acandra sūryam harayo dadṛśū roma harṣaṇam ।niśamya tasmāt siṁhāḥ ca tān tān ca mṛga pakṣiṇaḥ ॥4-50-18॥

translations.english: The tigers among the monkeys entered the dark cave reverberating with the sounds of lions, beasts and birds.
translations.hindi: उसीके दिए हुए बर से में इस उत्तम बन की रक्षा करती हूँ । अब तुस बतलाओ तुम किस कार्य के लिये अथवा किस कारणवश इस वन में आए हो। इस दुगमवन को तुमने किस प्रकार देखा

verses.sloka: प्रविष्टा हरि शार्दूला बिलम् तिमिर आवृतम् ।न तेषाम् सज्जते दृष्टिः न तेजः न पराक्रमः ॥४-५०-१९॥
verses.transliteration: praviṣṭā hari śārdūlā bilam timira āvṛtam ।na teṣām sajjate dṛṣṭiḥ na tejaḥ na parākramaḥ ॥4-50-19॥

translations.english: The monkeys could not fix their eyes anywhere.Their lustre or valour could not help them. They moved like wind uninterrupted and their vision was lost in darkness.
translations.hindi: उसने ही यह सब सुवणंमय बन अपवी माया के बल से बनाया हे । पहले यह दानव, मुख्यदानवो का Se शिल्पी था

verses.sloka: वायोः इव गतिः तेषाम् दृष्टिः तम् अपि वर्तते ।ते प्रविष्टाः तु वेगेन तत् बिलम् कपि कुंजराः ॥४-५०-२०॥
verses.transliteration: vāyoḥ iva gatiḥ teṣām dṛṣṭiḥ tam api vartate ।te praviṣṭāḥ tu vegena tat bilam kapi kuṁjarāḥ ॥4-50-20॥

translations.english: As the elephantlike monkeys entered the cave quickly, they saw bright light and an excellent delightful place.

verses.sloka: प्रकाशम् च अभिरामम् च ददृशुः देशम् उत्तमम् ।ततः तस्मिन् बिले भीमे नाना पादप संकुले ॥४-५०-२१॥
verses.transliteration: prakāśam ca abhirāmam ca dadṛśuḥ deśam uttamam ।tataḥ tasmin bile bhīme nānā pādapa saṁkule ॥4-50-21॥

translations.english: Holding one another's hands, they went in for a distance of one yojana inside the cave that was densely covered with several kinds of trees.

verses.sloka: अन्योन्यम् संपरिष्वज्य जग्मुर् योजनम् अंतरम् ।ते नष्ट संज्ञाः तृषिताः संभ्रांताः सलिल अर्थिनः ॥४-५०-२२॥
verses.transliteration: anyonyam saṁpariṣvajya jagmur yojanam aṁtaram ।te naṣṭa saṁjñāḥ tṛṣitāḥ saṁbhrāṁtāḥ salila arthinaḥ ॥4-50-22॥

translations.english: Having nearly lost their senses (without water to drink), the thirsty and bewildered monkeys were desperate for water.They wandered in the cave without feeling lazy for some time.

verses.sloka: परिपेतुर् बिले तस्मिन् कंचित् कालम् अतन्द्रिताः ।ते कृशा दीन वदनाः परिश्रान्ताः प्लवंगमाः ॥४-५०-२३॥
verses.transliteration: paripetur bile tasmin kaṁcit kālam atandritāḥ ।te kṛśā dīna vadanāḥ pariśrāntāḥ plavaṁgamāḥ ॥4-50-23॥

translations.english: Exhausted and enfeebled, they saw with dejected faces a gleam of light at a time when they were desparate.

verses.sloka: आलोकम् ददृशुः वीरा निराशा जीविते यदा ।ततः तम् देशम् आगम्य सौम्याः वितिमिरम् वनम् ॥४-५०-२४॥
verses.transliteration: ālokam dadṛśuḥ vīrā nirāśā jīvite yadā ।tataḥ tam deśam āgamya saumyāḥ vitimiram vanam ॥4-50-24॥

translations.english: Having reached inside the cave the monkeys saw a forest shining like blazing fire, dispelling the surrounding darkness. There they noticed sala, tala, tamala, punnaga, vanjjula, dhava, champaka, and naga trees. They also saw blossoming plants of Karnikara, bunches of beautiful golden flowers and tender redcoloured leaves.They saw wonderful trees with creepers on top entwining them, and ornamented with gold (like golden fruits), radiant like the dazzling rising Sun. There were altars encrusted with precious sapphire and vaidurya. The golden trees were shining bright. There were lotus creepers looking like sapphire and vaidurya.The ponds were filled with golden lotuses and were surrounded by birds.

verses.sloka: ददृशुः कान्चनान् वृक्षान् दीप्त वैश्वानर प्रभान् ।सालान् तालान् तमालान् च पुन्नागान् वंजुलान् धवान् ॥४-५०-२५॥
verses.transliteration: dadṛśuḥ kāncanān vṛkṣān dīpta vaiśvānara prabhān ।sālān tālān tamālān ca punnāgān vaṁjulān dhavān ॥4-50-25॥

translations.english: Having reached inside the cave the monkeys saw a forest shining like blazing fire, dispelling the surrounding darkness. There they noticed sala, tala, tamala, punnaga, vanjjula, dhava, champaka, and naga trees. They also saw blossoming plants of Karnikara, bunches of beautiful golden flowers and tender redcoloured leaves.They saw wonderful trees with creepers on top entwining them, and ornamented with gold (like golden fruits), radiant like the dazzling rising Sun. There were altars encrusted with precious sapphire and vaidurya. The golden trees were shining bright. There were lotus creepers looking like sapphire and vaidurya.The ponds were filled with golden lotuses and were surrounded by birds.

verses.sloka: चंपकान् नाग वृक्षान् च कर्णिकारान् च पुष्पितान् ।स्तबकैः कांचनैः चित्रैः रक्तैः किसलयैः तथा ॥४-५०-२६॥
verses.transliteration: caṁpakān nāga vṛkṣān ca karṇikārān ca puṣpitān ।stabakaiḥ kāṁcanaiḥ citraiḥ raktaiḥ kisalayaiḥ tathā ॥4-50-26॥

translations.english: Having reached inside the cave the monkeys saw a forest shining like blazing fire, dispelling the surrounding darkness. There they noticed sala, tala, tamala, punnaga, vanjjula, dhava, champaka, and naga trees. They also saw blossoming plants of Karnikara, bunches of beautiful golden flowers and tender redcoloured leaves.They saw wonderful trees with creepers on top entwining them, and ornamented with gold (like golden fruits), radiant like the dazzling rising Sun. There were altars encrusted with precious sapphire and vaidurya. The golden trees were shining bright. There were lotus creepers looking like sapphire and vaidurya.The ponds were filled with golden lotuses and were surrounded by birds.

verses.sloka: आपीडैः च लताभिः च हेम आभरण भूषितैः ।तरुण आदित्य संकाशान् वैदूर्यमय वेदिकान् ॥४-५०-२७॥
verses.transliteration: āpīḍaiḥ ca latābhiḥ ca hema ābharaṇa bhūṣitaiḥ ।taruṇa āditya saṁkāśān vaidūryamaya vedikān ॥4-50-27॥

translations.english: Having reached inside the cave the monkeys saw a forest shining like blazing fire, dispelling the surrounding darkness. There they noticed sala, tala, tamala, punnaga, vanjjula, dhava, champaka, and naga trees. They also saw blossoming plants of Karnikara, bunches of beautiful golden flowers and tender redcoloured leaves.They saw wonderful trees with creepers on top entwining them, and ornamented with gold (like golden fruits), radiant like the dazzling rising Sun. There were altars encrusted with precious sapphire and vaidurya. The golden trees were shining bright. There were lotus creepers looking like sapphire and vaidurya.The ponds were filled with golden lotuses and were surrounded by birds.

verses.sloka: विभ्राजमानान् वपुषा पादपान् च हिरण्मयान् ।नील वैदूर्य वर्णाः च पद्मिनीः पतगैः आवृताः ॥४-५०-२८॥
verses.transliteration: vibhrājamānān vapuṣā pādapān ca hiraṇmayān ।nīla vaidūrya varṇāḥ ca padminīḥ patagaiḥ āvṛtāḥ ॥4-50-28॥

translations.english: Having reached inside the cave the monkeys saw a forest shining like blazing fire, dispelling the surrounding darkness. There they noticed sala, tala, tamala, punnaga, vanjjula, dhava, champaka, and naga trees. They also saw blossoming plants of Karnikara, bunches of beautiful golden flowers and tender redcoloured leaves.They saw wonderful trees with creepers on top entwining them, and ornamented with gold (like golden fruits), radiant like the dazzling rising Sun. There were altars encrusted with precious sapphire and vaidurya. The golden trees were shining bright. There were lotus creepers looking like sapphire and vaidurya.The ponds were filled with golden lotuses and were surrounded by birds.

verses.sloka: महद्भिः कांचनैः वृक्षैः वृता बाल अर्क संनिभैः ।जातरूपमयैः मत्स्यैः महद्भिः च अथ पन्कजैः ॥४-५०-२९॥
verses.transliteration: mahadbhiḥ kāṁcanaiḥ vṛkṣaiḥ vṛtā bāla arka saṁnibhaiḥ ।jātarūpamayaiḥ matsyaiḥ mahadbhiḥ ca atha pankajaiḥ ॥4-50-29॥

translations.english: There they saw golden fishes and huge tortoises in the pellucid water of the tank filled with lotus creepers.

verses.sloka: नलिनीः तत्र ददृशुः प्रसन्न सलिल आयुताः ।कांचनानि विमानानि राजतानि तथा एव च ॥४-५०-३०॥
verses.transliteration: nalinīḥ tatra dadṛśuḥ prasanna salila āyutāḥ ।kāṁcanāni vimānāni rājatāni tathā eva ca ॥4-50-30॥

translations.english: The vanaras beheld highrise palaces built with gold and silver. The windows fixed on the roof were golden, shaped like cow's eye with lattices of pearls. They also saw best of houses built in gold, silver and clay, decorated with precious gems including vaidurya.

verses.sloka: तपनीय गवाक्षाणि मुक्ता जाल आवृतानि च ।हैम राजत भौमानि वैदूर्य मणिमन्ति च ॥४-५०-३१॥
verses.transliteration: tapanīya gavākṣāṇi muktā jāla āvṛtāni ca ।haima rājata bhaumāni vaidūrya maṇimanti ca ॥4-50-31॥

translations.english: The vanaras beheld highrise palaces built with gold and silver. The windows fixed on the roof were golden, shaped like cow's eye with lattices of pearls. They also saw best of houses built in gold, silver and clay, decorated with precious gems including vaidurya.

verses.sloka: ददृशुः तत्र हरयो गृह मुख्यानि सर्वशः ।पुष्पितान् फलिनो वृक्षान् प्रवाल मणि संनिभान् ॥४-५०-३२॥
verses.transliteration: dadṛśuḥ tatra harayo gṛha mukhyāni sarvaśaḥ ।puṣpitān phalino vṛkṣān pravāla maṇi saṁnibhān ॥4-50-32॥

translations.english: They saw trees bright like corals in full bloom and ripe fruits. Golden bees were found hovering around making all kinds of honey.

verses.sloka: कांचन भ्रमरान् चैव मधूनि च समन्ततः ।मणि कांचन चित्राणि शयनानि आसनानि च ॥४-५०-३३॥
verses.transliteration: kāṁcana bhramarān caiva madhūni ca samantataḥ ।maṇi kāṁcana citrāṇi śayanāni āsanāni ca ॥4-50-33॥

translations.english: They saw all over rich collections of beds, couches and highly valuable vehicles, decorated beautifully with gems and gold.They also saw a large collection of shining utensils made of gold, silver and bronze.

verses.sloka: विविधानि विशालानि ददृशुः ते समन्ततः ।हेम रजत कांस्यानाम् भाजनानाम् च राशयः ॥४-५०-३४॥
verses.transliteration: vividhāni viśālāni dadṛśuḥ te samantataḥ ।hema rajata kāṁsyānām bhājanānām ca rāśayaḥ ॥4-50-34॥

translations.english: They saw all over rich collections of beds, couches and highly valuable vehicles, decorated beautifully with gems and gold.They also saw a large collection of shining utensils made of gold, silver and bronze.

verses.sloka: अगुरूणाम् च दिव्यानाम् चंदनानाम् च संचयम् ।शुचीनि अभ्यवहाराणि मूलानि च फलानि च ॥४-५०-३५॥
verses.transliteration: agurūṇām ca divyānām caṁdanānām ca saṁcayam ।śucīni abhyavahārāṇi mūlāni ca phalāni ca ॥4-50-35॥

translations.english: There they noticed a wonderful collection of incense and sandal, tasty and pure eatables, roots and fruits

verses.sloka: महा अर्हाणि च पानानि मधूनि रसवन्ति च ।दिव्यानाम् अम्बराणाम् च महा अर्हाणाम् च संचयान् ॥४-५०-३६॥
verses.transliteration: mahā arhāṇi ca pānāni madhūni rasavanti ca ।divyānām ambarāṇām ca mahā arhāṇām ca saṁcayān ॥4-50-36॥

translations.english: (They found) excellent drinks and many kinds of honey, wonderful collections of clothes, colourful blankets and heaps of animal skin.

verses.sloka: कंबलानाम् च चित्राणाम् अजिनानाम् च संचयान् ।तत्र तत्र विन्यस्तान् दीप्तान् वैश्वानर प्रभान् ॥४-५०-३७॥
verses.transliteration: kaṁbalānām ca citrāṇām ajinānām ca saṁcayān ।tatra tatra vinyastān dīptān vaiśvānara prabhān ॥4-50-37॥

translations.english: The monkeys marked here and there a collection of gold, glittering like blazing fire.

verses.sloka: ददृशुः वानराः शुभ्रान् जातरूपस्य संचयान् ।तत्र तत्र विचिन्वन्तो बिले तत्र महा प्रभाः ॥४-५०-३८॥
verses.transliteration: dadṛśuḥ vānarāḥ śubhrān jātarūpasya saṁcayān ।tatra tatra vicinvanto bile tatra mahā prabhāḥ ॥4-50-38॥

translations.english: While searching here and there in the cave, the strong and powerful monkeys discovered a woman not far from there.

verses.sloka: ददृशुः वानराः शूराः स्त्रियम् कांचित् अदूरतः ।ताम् च ते ददृशुः तत्र चीर कृष्ण अजिन अम्बराम् ॥४-५०-३९॥
verses.transliteration: dadṛśuḥ vānarāḥ śūrāḥ striyam kāṁcit adūrataḥ ।tām ca te dadṛśuḥ tatra cīra kṛṣṇa ajina ambarām ॥4-50-39॥

translations.english: She was an ascetic in bark robes and deer skin blazing with lustre, restrained in her food. The monkeys got very frightened.

verses.sloka: तापसीम् नियत आहाराम् ज्वलंतीम् इव तेजसा ।विस्मिता हरयः तत्र व्यवतिष्टन्त सर्वशः ।प्रपच्छ हनुमान् तत्र का असि त्वम् कस्य वा बिलम् ॥४-५०-४०॥
verses.transliteration: tāpasīm niyata āhārām jvalaṁtīm iva tejasā ।vismitā harayaḥ tatra vyavatiṣṭanta sarvaśaḥ ।prapaccha hanumān tatra kā asi tvam kasya vā bilam ॥4-50-40॥

translations.english: The amazed monkeys stopped there. Hanuman enquired, 'Who are you? Whose cave is this'?

verses.sloka: ततो हनूमान् गिरि सन्निकाशःकृत अंजलिः ताम् अभिवाद्य वृद्धाम् ।पप्रच्छ का त्वम् भवनम् बिलम् चरत्नानि च इमानि वदस्व कस्य ॥४-५०-४१॥
verses.transliteration: tato hanūmān giri sannikāśaḥkṛta aṁjaliḥ tām abhivādya vṛddhām ।papraccha kā tvam bhavanam bilam caratnāni ca imāni vadasva kasya ॥4-50-41॥

translations.english: Then Hanuman who was of the size of a mountain greeted the old lady with folded hands and enquired her 'Who are you? To whom does this mansion, this cave and these gems belong?' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे पञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends of fiftieth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic of the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
